description: Circuit breaker finite state machine fails to transition back from HALF_OPEN to CLOSED state upon meeting the required success probe threshold.
spec_notes: Invariant: In HALF_OPEN state, after reaching success_threshold consecutive successes, circuit must transition to CLOSED and reset failure counts.

repo_files.state.py:
from enum import Enum

class CircuitState(str, Enum):
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"
    OPEN = "OPEN"
    HALF_OPEN = "HALF_OPEN"

tests.test_circuit_breaker.py:
from circuit_breaker import CircuitBreaker, CircuitBreakerOpenException
from state import CircuitState

def test_closed_state_success():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=3)
    assert cb.can_execute(100.0) is True
    cb.record_success()
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.CLOSED

def test_trip_to_open_on_failures():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=2, recovery_timeout=5.0)
    cb.record_failure(100.0)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.CLOSED
    cb.record_failure(101.0)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.OPEN
    assert cb.can_execute(103.0) is False # Still in recovery period

def test_recovery_from_half_open_to_closed():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=5, recovery_timeout=5.0, success_threshold=2)
    cb.record_failure(100.0)
    cb.record_failure(100.0)
    cb.record_failure(100.0)
    cb.record_failure(100.0)
    cb.record_failure(100.0) # Tripped open
    
    assert cb.can_execute(106.0) is True # Transitions to HALF_OPEN
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN
    
    cb.record_success() # Probe 1
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN
    cb.record_success() # Probe 2 -> Meets success_threshold (2)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.CLOSED # Must be closed now
